rules: body { margin: 0px; font: 16px / 1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }
h1 { line-height: 1.1; font-size: 44px; margin: 12px 0px 20px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
input:not([type="checkbox"]), select { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0px; background: white; color: var(--ink); }
button { min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0px; background: var(--accent); color: white; cursor: pointer; }
.panel { background: white; border: 2px solid var(--ink); padding: 28px; margin-top: 28px; }
.checkbox-label { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; margin: 0px; cursor: pointer; padding: 10px 0px; }

input[type="checkbox"] { appearance: none; flex: 0 0 22px; width: 22px; height: 22px; margin: 1px 0px 0px; border: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0px; display: grid; place-content: center; background: white; color: white; cursor: pointer; }
input[type="checkbox"]:checked::after { content: ""; width: 10px; height: 6px; border-left: 2px solid; border-bottom: 2px solid; transform: translateY(-1px) rotate(-45deg); }
.visually-hidden { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0px; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; border: 0px; }
